card_en: Masculine nouns for things stay the same as the object: kruh, jem kruh. Those for people and animals take -a: brat, imam brata. Neuter nouns stay the same too: meso, jem meso.

quick_check.explain_en: Sin is a person, so as the object it takes -a: imam sina in hčerko.

helper_de: German changes der to den for every masculine object: den Kuchen, den Bruder. Slovenian changes only nouns for people and animals: imam brata, but jem kruh.
helper_en: English never changes the noun. Slovenian changes a masculine one only when it is alive: imam brata, but jem kruh.
